# Pop It

> Pop It is a bubble-popping speed game for iPhone. Only the ringed bubbles count: pop them as fast as you can, avoid the wrong ones, and beat your best time across 200 levels. Free, no ads, no account, works offline.

Pop It is a casual mobile game made by Yoav Sabag. Each level highlights a few bubbles with a ring. The player taps only those, and every tap on a plain bubble adds 1.000 seconds to their time. Clearing a level always unlocks the next one; the time only decides whether it is a new personal best.

## Key features

- 200 levels that get trickier: static targets at first, then targets that flash and targets that slide to a neighbouring bubble.
- Best times: the best time is saved for every level.
- Free pop: a relaxing mode with no timer and a choice of bubble themes.
- Sound, haptics and a looping music track, with a mute switch.
- Private: no ads, no in-app purchases, no analytics, no account and no network use. Progress is stored only on the device.

- Platform: iPhone. An Android version is planned.
- Pricing: free, with no ads or in-app purchases.
- Pop It collects no personal data.
